description: This file defines an interface for querying basket-related data, specifically a method to count the total number of basket items for a given user, without executing the query in memory.

classes.name: IBasketQueryService
classes.description: An interface that declares a method to asynchronously count total basket items for a specific user.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the total count of basket items for the specified username.
